description.zh:
备份计划ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **BackupPlanId**或**BackupSetDownloadTaskId**任选其一作为请求参数必填项。
description.en:
The ID of the backup plan. Call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

> You must specify either **BackupPlanId** or **BackupSetDownloadTaskId**.

description.zh:
备份集下载任务ID。

- 全量备份：可通过调用[CreateFullBackupSetDownload](~~2869842~~)接口获取该参数的值。
- 增量备份：可通过调用[CreateIncrementBackupSetDownload](~~2869843~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en:
The ID of the backup set download task.

- For a full backup, call the [CreateFullBackupSetDownload](~~2869842~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

- For an incremental backup, call the [CreateIncrementBackupSetDownload](~~2869843~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

description.zh: 输入任意值，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. This prevents duplicate requests.

description.zh: 页码，大于等于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值为0。
description.en: The page number. The value must be a non-negative integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the integer type. The default value is 0.

description.zh:
每页的记录数，取值30、50、100。

> 默认每页记录数为30。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

> The default value is 30.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs describe-backup-set-download-task-list --backup-plan-id dbsqhnuhyw30000 --backup-set-download-task-id urxgrxt70000 --page-size 30 --page-num 1 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzXXXXXX --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs DescribeBackupSetDownloadTaskList --region cn-hangzhou --BackupSetDownloadTaskId urxgrxt70000 --PageSize 30 --PageNum 1 --BackupPlanId dbsqhnuhyw30000 --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzXXXXXX
